verification: Actually fetched institutional HTML; leads only, not fact or publication approval. Scope-sensitive review remains mandatory.

entries.scope: Common dry edible bean classes; kidney and white/navy are not interchangeable cultivars. US trial observations only, never an Iranian yield promise. Keep market class, region, harvest moisture and units explicit.
entries.scientific_crop_mapping: Phaseolus vulgaris, red kidney market class; not every dry bean cultivar; Phaseolus vulgaris, white-seeded market types; navy data is navy-specific, not every white bean

entries.scope: Alfalfa dry matter by cutting; fresh mass cannot be inferred without measured dry matter. Distinguish US short tons, metric tonnes, seasonal totals and per-cut production.
entries.scientific_crop_mapping: Medicago sativa alfalfa, fresh forage versus dry matter must be explicit

entries.scope: Pumpkin fruit marketable versus total yield; not seed yield or identical to zucchini. US cultivar/site observations only.
entries.scientific_crop_mapping: pumpkin fruit; distinguish species, winter squash and seed yield

entries.scope: Immature summer squash/zucchini fresh market yield, not winter pumpkin fruit or extracted seeds. Preserve per-plant versus per-area denominators.
entries.scientific_crop_mapping: Cucurbita pepo summer squash, zucchini harvested as immature fruit

entries.scope: Qualitative selection criteria for Sesame/Sesamum indicum; do not recommend US cultivars for Iran or transfer US contract availability.
Chickpea/Cicer arietinum, desi vs kabuli criteria; not pea or cowpea. Local adaptation and seed contracts must not be inferred for Iran.
entries.scientific_crop_mapping: Cicer arietinum chickpea/garbanzo, desi and kabuli criteria

entries.scope: Pisum sativum. Explicitly distinguish dry harvested grain, shelled green peas and fresh pods; no southern pea/cowpea substitution. The generic title does not choose one harvested form. Use only forms actually supported, identify the form prominently, and never apply dry-grain observations to fresh-green yield.
entries.scientific_crop_mapping: Pisum sativum, distinguish fresh green product from dry grain

entries.scope: Vicia sativa common vetch only; generic Persian vetch may be ambiguous. Separate forage dry matter, fresh biomass and harvested seed. Never transfer one product to another.
entries.scientific_crop_mapping: Vicia genus; common-vetch evidence applies ONLY to Vicia sativa and stated harvested product

entries.scope: Tomato plant spacing and deterministic nursery need calculations. Require row spacing, in-row spacing and paths/bed definition; never invent mortality percentages.
Seed pumpkin maturity and spacing; distinguish edible seed harvest from Halloween flesh/color. Generic pumpkin fruit maturity cannot prove edible seed maturity or cultivar-specific planting density.
entries.scientific_crop_mapping: seed-purpose Cucurbita cultivars; ordinary pumpkin-fruit evidence is not automatically edible-seed evidence

entries.scope: Lentil/Lens culinaris maturity, shattering and seed quality; no US seasonal calendar, pesticide/desiccant rates or numeric moisture prescription for Iran.
Mungbean/Vigna radiata pod maturity, not black gram or cowpea; distinguish uneven pods, shattering and market quality. No US calendar transferred.
entries.scientific_crop_mapping: Vigna radiata mungbean, not cowpea or black gram

entries.scope: Edible-seed watermelon cultivar-type criteria only, not dessert fruit or Cucumeropsis mannii. Iranian named seed cultivars and equivalence to African egusi cannot be assumed. Genetic papers are not local yield trials.
entries.scientific_crop_mapping: edible-seed watermelon Citrullus types; do not assume equivalence to African egusi or dessert watermelon

entries.scope: University of Minnesota GENERAL field soil-moisture sensor placement methods: representative soil zones, crop-row placement, root-zone-relative depth and direct soil contact. NOT a pinto-specific fixed rooting depth, local trigger, calendar interval or irrigation rate. Determine actual active root depth in the field. Distinguish live Phaseolus vulgaris crop from stored dry grain; do not import chickpea or soybean rooting depths.
entries.scientific_crop_mapping: Living field crop Phaseolus vulgaris L., pinto market class; sensor method is general and must retain that limit.
